text:
```yaml
name: CLAUDE Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test-slurm-cli:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.10
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run script with explicit CLI args
        run: |
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py \
            --slurm \
            --account test_account \
            --partition test_partition \
            --time_limit 01:00:00 \
            --job_dir /tmp/test_job_dir \
            --custom_mounts /tmp/mount1:/tmp/mount2 \
            --dry_run

      - name: Run script with env var fallbacks
        env:
          ACCOUNT: test_account_env
          PARTITION: test_partition_env
          NEMORUN_HOME: /tmp/nemorun_home
          CUSTOM_MOUNTS: /tmp/mount_env1:/tmp/mount_env2
        run: |
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py \
            --slurm \
            --time_limit 01:00:00 \
            --job_dir /tmp/test_job_dir_env \
            --dry_run
```
